# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## Scoring mechanism: reward = DB-state-match × COMMUNICATE
- What worked (confirmed by cand_0002 ACCEPTED +0.060): reward_basis=(DB,COMMUNICATE) — verified in the val tasks.json and evaluator.py. ACTION checks are computed but NOT part of the reward. So any wrapper-side edit that makes the correct WRITE land in the live DB (arg normalization, and — cand_0003 — active arg-correction + retry) is a legitimate, direct reward lever. Do not optimize for action_checks.
- What didn't (confirmed unsafe by data, not yet by a RESULT): authoritative CODE override of nonfree_baggages — gold task 33 (gold/economy/1 pax) has nonfree=2, which the policy free-bag formula cannot yield; an override would be wrong and risk regression. Ship docstring knowledge instead.
- Promising but not yet tried: a price-compute helper (per-cabin fare + $30/pax insurance + $50/nonfree-bag) so the agent presents a correct total and the simulated user proceeds — targets the action-stall cluster without touching refusal/transfer logic (must be validated against gold before shipping).

## Zero-blast-radius edit pattern (safe on write tools)
- What worked (cand_0002 ACCEPTED, broke={—}): gate every recovery/normalization on the primitive's ERROR STRING (success returns a dict). Correct inputs pass through unchanged in ONE call, so no passing task can change. cand_0003 extends the same envelope to active retry. The 10 passing tasks {0,13,16,26,28,36,41,43,46,47} mostly don't call the write tools; task 16 calls update_reservation_flights with a VALID id → success path → recovery never fires.
- Verify each such edit with mock env_* primitives: bad input → single retry/enriched string; good input → dict passthrough, ONE call (catches accidental double-writes).
